claims.evidence: Brand text on frame is not legible in photo 0, and no folding hinge or mechanism is visible to confirm 'folding' type.
Subjective durability claim cannot be assessed from a single top-down photo.
Tire tread/pressure and brake lever/pad function are not shown or testable from the photo.
No derailleur, chain, or gear-shifting detail visible or described by witness.
No purchase receipt, date-stamped photo, or wear pattern evidence provided.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original
claims.evidence: Witness explicitly notes gear/brake condition, rust on unseen sides, and originality of parts were 'not_shown'.

risks.risk: Hidden rust or frame damage on unseen sides
risks.proof: Clear photos of both frame sides, underside, and joints in good light
risks.if_unproven: Price as if moderate rust/cosmetic damage may be present

risks.proof: Short video clip squeezing both brake levers showing pad contact and wheel stopping

risks.risk: Gear system not shifting properly or damaged derailleur
risks.proof: Video clip cycling through all gears while pedaling
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears non-functional or needing repair

risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires including tread and sidewalls, plus inflated tire shot
Video spinning each wheel showing no wobble against a fixed reference point
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels possibly needing truing/replacement

risks.risk: Folding mechanism may not exist or may be faulty if bike is actually a standard (non-folding) frame
risks.proof: Photo/video of the bike folded and unfolded, showing the hinge mechanism
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard non-folding bicycle, not as folding-premium model

risks.risk: Unverifiable age/usage history, possible heavier wear than '6 months' claim
risks.proof: Photo of original receipt/box or serial number cross-check
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycle of unknown age, not as near-new

proof_requests: Multiple angle photos: both sides of frame, underside, headtube badge/brand logo close-up
Video of folding mechanism in action (fold and unfold)
Video of brake test (squeeze levers, show wheel stopping)
Close-up photos of both tires (tread and sidewall)
Video spinning each wheel to check trueness
Photo of original receipt or proof of purchase date if available
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a bicycle, so a worst-case price can be set, but brand, folding feature, and all functional/condition claims remain unverified or unverifiable remotely and must be priced conservatively until proof is supplied.
